inferences: the tag-3 and tag-4 queries are siblings of the tag-5/tag-6 twins in the open PR #3001 packet: same throttle gate, same handler-chain walk, same framing and delivery, but different tags, a one-link-deeper walk, and different payloads

the gate is a throttle: the message is built only while the target's slot +0x20 return does not exceed the limit at obj+0x08, while the tag's flag bit in obj+0x18 is clear, and once every limit-at-obj+0x10 qualifying calls

the tag-3 callers walk a linked list (nodes via +0xf8) and issue one tag-3 query per node, with the obj either carried in rsi or reloaded from +0x650 of a stack object; the tag-4 callers each call 0x606ca40 first and pass the obj from +0x650 of a register object, null-checked
the tag-3 message's first 8 bytes are a presence mask with only bit 1 set (0x02); the tag-4 message's mask has bits 2 and 3 set (0x0c)
